concerns.text: T012 requires 'referencing actual output cells and figure files', but the figures are produced by T011. The stated order 'T011/T012/T013 (T011–T013 partially parallel)' permits T012 to run before/concurrent with T011, a consumer-before-producer dependency on figures/. T012 must be explicitly sequenced after T011 (T013 may remain parallel).

T008 and T009 consume the full-sweep results and produce analysis_report.json / sensitivity_report.json, yet T010 — 'Execute the complete pipeline end-to-end... verify aggregate metrics... recomputed aggregates match the analysis inputs' — is scheduled AFTER them. The independent verification of the data feeding the analysis arrives after the analysis has already run. Reorder T010 before T008, or restate T010 as a post-hoc audit that may invalidate T008/T009 outputs.

T008's granularity-validation sweep and T009's pruning-interval sweep both require NEW agent executions (denser 10-unit grid; intervals {5,10,15}), i.e. they consume code/agent.py and code/pruning.py as producers of new log data, but are written as pure additions to code/analysis.py. The tasks should name where these extra run artifacts are written and confirm they append to the same validated log store, so the analysis-vs-execution producer/consumer boundary is explicit.
